headline: Approved 2025 tax abatements for several properties, denied others, and tabled an abatement for uncollectable back taxes.
summary: Approved 2025 abatements for 64 Coburn Woods, 60 Timberline Dr, 3 Theresa Way, and 5 Theresa Way. Denied 2025 abatements for 18 addresses, including 15 Raymond St and 23 Raymond St. Approved one Current Use application and tabled an administrative abatement of uncollectable back taxes to August 6, 2026.
decisions: Approved the 2025 abatement for 64 Coburn Woods, all in favor.
Approved the 2025 abatement for 60 Timberline Dr, all in favor.
Approved the 2025 abatements for 3 Theresa Way and 5 Theresa Way, all in favor.
Denied the 2025 abatements for 188 Bartemus Trl, 35 Walden Pond Dr, 84 Walden Pond Dr, 22 New Dunstable Rd, and 20 Lake St, all in favor.
Denied the 2025 abatement for 15 Raymond St, 2 in favor and 1 abstention.
Denied the 2025 abatement for 23 Raymond St, 2 in favor and 1 abstention.

Denied the 2025 abatements for 10 Blanchard St, 73 Avon Dr, 77 Avon Dr, 78 Avon Dr, 9 Warner St, 20 Academy Dr, 7 Sirelle Ct, 2 Lancaster Dr, 4 Lancaster Dr, 7 Fountain Ln, and 41 Berkeley St, all in favor.
Approved the Current Use application as presented, all in favor.
Tabled the administrative abatement of uncollectable back taxes to the August 6, 2026 Assessors meeting, all in favor.

plain_text:
1 
 
 The Public Minutes of the Board of Assessors 
Meeting of July 16, 2026 
A meeting of the Board of Assessors was held on Thursday, July 16, 2026 in the 3rd Floor Auditorium at 
Nashua City Hall, located at 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH  03060.  The meeting was called to order at 9:00 AM 
by Charles Dobens. 
Members Present: 
Robert Earley, Jay Minkarah, Charles Dobens 
Contracted Assessors: 
Bob Gagne 
 
Assessing Staff Present:  
Jessica Marchant, Michelle Welsh, Kevin Bilafer 
 
Other City of Nashua Staff Present:  
Celia Leonard, Michael Lehman 
  
I’ll call the meeting of the Nashua Board of Assessors to order at 9:00 AM on Thursday, July 16, 2026.   
Let the record show that present from the Board are Robert Earley, Jay Minkarah and myself, Charles Dobens. 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to waive the reading of the public minutes from the Board of Assessors meeting 
held on May 7, 2026, accept them and place them on file.    
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to waive the reading of the non-public minutes from the Board of Assessors 
meeting held on Thursday, May 7, 2026, accept them and place them on file.   
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
COMMUNICATIONS: 
Department Update: None 
 
OLD BUSINESS:   
None 
 
NEW BUSINESS:   
2025 Abatements for Approval and Denial 
J. Marchant and B. Gagne presented the abatements for approval.  
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to approve the 2025 abatement for 64 Coburn Woods as presented. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to approve the 2025 abatement for 60 Timberline Dr as presented. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor
2 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to approve the 2025 abatements for 3 Theresa Way and 5 Theresa Way as 
presented. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
C. Dobens read part of the list of addresses with abatements recommended for denial: 
188 BARTEMUS TRL 
35 WALDEN POND DR 
84 WALDEN POND DR 
22 NEW DUNSTABLE RD 
20 LAKE ST 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to deny the 2025 abatements per the list read. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
J. Minkarah recused himself from voting on two of the abatements recommended for denial.  
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to deny the abatement for 15 Raymond St. 
SECONDED BY Charles Dobens 
VOTE: 2 in favor and 1 abstention 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to deny the abatement for 23 Raymond St. 
SECONDED BY Charles Dobens 
VOTE: 2 in favor and 1 abstention 
 
C. Dobens read the rest of the list of addresses with abatements recommended for denial: 
10 BLANCHARD ST 
73 AVON DR 
77 AVON DR 
78 AVON DR 
9 WARNER ST 
20 ACADEMY DR 
7 SIRELLE CT 
2 LANCASTER DR 
4 LANCASTER DR 
7 FOUNTAIN LN 
41 BERKELEY ST 
 
B. Gagne gave some background information to the board regarding the abatements filed due to 
unconstitutional grounds and explained the argument is against being charged the school tax rate.  
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to deny the 2025 abatements per the list read. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor
3 
 
Current Use application for Approval 
R. Gagne presented the Current Use application for approval. 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to approve the application for Current Use as presented. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
Abatement of uncollectable back taxes 
J. Marchant and B. Gagne presented the administrative abatement for uncollectable taxes. 
Attorney Leonard posed some questions as to whether the previous owner could be held accountable to pay the 
back taxes. She suggested the board not take action today in order to organize a cross-department meeting to 
discuss the matter before granting the abatement.  
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to table the administrative abatement to the August 6, 2026 Assessors meeting. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT: 
Peter Jacobson, 3 Bartemus Trl U-206 noted he submitted an application for the disabled veteran’s credit after 
the application deadline. He explained his reasons for filing late due to illness of himself and his family member 
and asked the board to consider his 2026 application under RSA 72:33 citing accident, mistake or misfortune.  
 
COMMENTS BY BOARD MEMBERS:  
None 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to go into non-public session for two reasons, first to discuss matters which, if 
discussed in public, would likely affect adversely the reputation of any person, other than a member of this 
board, unless such person requests an open meeting. This exemption shall extend to include any application for 
assistance or tax abatement or waiver of a fee, fine or other levy, if based on inability to pay or poverty of the 
applicant, pursuant to RSA 91-A:3, Ⅱ (C). Second, under 91-A:3, II (L), for the “consideration of legal advice 
provided by legal counsel, either in writing or orally, to one or more members of the public body, even where 
legal counsel is not present.”   
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE:  
Mr. Minkarah - Yes 
Mr. Earley – Yes 
Mr. Dobens – Yes 
 
The Board entered non-public session at 9:35AM 
The Board resumed public session at 10:03 AM
4 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to seal the minutes of the non-public session because divulgence of the 
information likely would 1) affect adversely the reputation of any person other than a member of this public 
body, and 2) render the proposed action ineffective.   
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY  Robert Earley to release the non-public minutes of May 7, 2026 as redacted.  
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to adjourn 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
The board adjourned at 10:04 AM 
Respectfully submitted,   
Jessica Marchant
